title: Billed and paid ahead of the work

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
At 31 March 2026 {customer} has been billed and has paid ₹30,00,000 on its contract, but Kalmira has recognised only ₹22,00,000 of revenue so far. What does Kalmira show for the ₹8,00,000 difference?

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.

rubric.text: Paid ahead of performance: contract liability.

explanation: When the customer pays before the entity performs, the entity shows a contract liability for its obligation to transfer the services (para 106).

mistakes.feedback: A contract asset arises when performance runs ahead of billing. Here the cash is ahead of performance, so Kalmira owes the customer work: a contract liability (para 106).
The customer has already paid, so nothing is still due from it. Kalmira owes the work: a contract liability (para 106).
